inputs.text: If court documents are accurate, this is a serious failure of honesty and accountability: ICE lawyers reportedly relied on a May memo to justify arresting thousands of people at immigration courts, even though prosecutors now say the memo authorized no such arrests. A country needs firm immigration enforcement, but it also needs officials to tell the truth and respect the law. Turning up for a legal proceeding should not become a trap; conduct like this undermines confidence in the very institutions responsible for maintaining order.
